description: Haltestellen - Landkreis Cham is a dataset listed in German national open data portal (GovData), an open data portal, published or maintained by open.bydata. Landkreis Cham: Transport und Verkehr Transport und Verkehr für das Gebiet des Landkreises Cham Dieser Datensatz ist ein Toplayer (thematische Sammlung) und enthält verschiedene Sublayer (Themen) mit Geodaten zu Aufgabenbereichen der Verwaltung für die Belange von Transport und Verkehr im Landkreis Cham. Coverage: open.bydata. The portal files it under the publisher open.bydata. Its tags are httpspublications.europa.euresourceauthoritydata-themegove, httpspublications.europa.euresourceauthoritydata-themeregi, httpspublications.europa.euresourceauthoritydata-themetran. It offers 8 resource(s) in HTTPS://DATA-LRA-CHA.OPENDATA.ARCGIS.COM/API/FEED/DCAT-AP/FTYPE/CSV, HTTPS://DATA-LRA-CHA.OPENDATA.ARCGIS.COM/API/FEED/DCAT-AP/FTYPE/GEOJSON, HTTPS://DATA-LRA-CHA.OPENDATA.ARCGIS.COM/API/FEED/DCAT-AP/FTYPE/HTML, HTTPS://DATA-LRA-CHA.OPENDATA.ARCGIS.COM/API/FEED/DCAT-AP/FTYPE/KML, HTTPS://DATA-LRA-CHA.OPENDATA.ARCGIS.COM/API/FEED/DCAT-AP/FTYPE/ZIP. The portal shows 2026-09-27 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-de-portal.
